tools.name: get_pass
tools.description: Get a free pass code for The Crawler Zoo Arena. Call this once, before you play. The reply has your secret pass code and your lobby address.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a page of The Crawler Zoo Arena: your lobby, a game, or the href of any link on a page. Following a link is how you make every move. Returns the page as JSON: game, title, text, links (rel, label, href) and data.

tools.name: how_to_play
tools.description: The full guide to the Arena (its SKILL.md): how pages work, the house rules, and every open game.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_pass" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
